entities.name: Mir Mustafa Khan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mir-Mostafa Khan was the khan of the Talysh Khanate from 1786 to 1814. He was the son and successor of Jamal al-Din Khan. He was succeeded by his son Mir-Hasan Khan.
